why_ai: Platform software built on screens with no licence; AI coding agents reshape what platforms even need.
why_clarity: Success is adoption, which nobody measures, and each organisation builds its platform differently.
why_digital: Code and infrastructure in, internal software out, bought and built remotely.

why_ai: Catalogue population and freshness are derivable, so AI-native tooling can replace operated portals.
why_clarity: Catalogue accuracy and operating cost are measurable, though deployments vary by organisation.
why_digital: Repository and service data in, a portal out, sold as software.

why_ai: Divergence from templates is computable and most updates are mechanical code changes AI agents make.
why_clarity: Conformance to a template is an exact diff, checkable instantly on every service.
why_digital: Templates and repositories in, code changes out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Learning what colleagues actually need takes product judgment and relationships inside the organisation.
why_clarity: Product management practice varies by team and adoption outcomes take quarters to read.
why_digital: Usage signals and developer conversations in, roadmap and platform changes out, mostly internal.

why_ai: Repetitive questions whose answers already live in the platform are prime work for an AI assistant.
why_clarity: The same questions recur forty times, and an answer is checkable against the platform.
why_digital: Chat questions in, written answers out, all in internal channels.

why_ai: Tooling vendors compete with building it yourself, and AI makes building it yourself cheaper.
why_clarity: Vendors are judged on operating cost and abstraction integrity, which vary by buyer.
why_digital: Software frameworks and portals sold and delivered online to platform teams.

why_ai: Every signal comes from systems the platform already runs, so instrumentation is standard software.
why_clarity: Product analytics metrics like activation and drop-off are well defined and quickly measured.
why_digital: Platform event data in, usage dashboards out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Deciding how much infrastructure to hide is a design judgment, but escape patterns are observable.
why_clarity: Abstraction coverage is observable, but where it should leak differs for each organisation.
why_digital: Infrastructure definitions in, provisioning software out, all on screen.

why_ai: Air-gapped and regulated estates restrict outside AI tools and require accountable control evidence.
why_clarity: Segregation of duties and change evidence follow defined control frameworks checked at audit.
why_digital: Code and controls on screen, but on-premise air-gapped estates limit remote vendors.

why_ai: Everything the catalogue records is observable elsewhere, so software can maintain it with no one.
why_clarity: Each catalogue entry is correct or stale against observable systems.
why_digital: Repository and runtime data in, an inventory out, entirely digital.

why_ai: The platform knows its own capabilities, so an AI assistant can tell developers before they build.
why_clarity: Whether a capability is supported is checkable, though developer needs vary by task.
why_digital: Developer queries in, capability answers out, entirely in software.
